newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr under seige as gains slip away.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr under seige as gains slip away.

text.p: The Australian dollar was holding just above 18-month lows late Wednesday having been slowly stripped of much of a 3/4 cent offshore rally.

The failure to press higher confirmed dealer suspicions the bounce was a mere short covering correction in a long term downtrend. Sentiment was soured by a mix of speculation about an official rate cut and weakness in commodity prices, all of which had dealers looking to sell into ther least sign of strength.
The only thing preventing a re-test of US$0.7410 right now was the fact the market was already very short of dollars, and bears were hoping for fresh incentive from jobs data Thursday.
